visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail and wearing a blue and white striped shirt stands by a massive floor-to-ceiling window, holding an infant. The background shows a hazy, high-altitude view of an urban landscape under a cloudy sky. (2) The scene transitions to multiple wide shots of the city skyline from above, capturing dense residential and commercial blocks with Taipei 101 visible in the background. The lighting is bright but diffused due to the overcast weather. (3) A street-level scene shows many pedestrians walking across a large zebra crossing at a busy urban intersection, with the bottom half of a green skyscraper dominating the left side of the frame. (4) Inside a cafe, a hand holds a white reservation card with the 'Simple Kaffa' logo. A person in a gray hoodie and a black stroller are seen next to the window. (5) The camera captures the interior of the cafe, highlighting dark green velvet banquette seating, circular green stools, and marble-textured tables. The setting is modern and clean with studio-style interior lighting. (6) Several close-ups of food and drinks follow: a clear glass of layered iced coffee, a glass of milk with a burnt sugar topping, three slices of toast with yellow, purple, and green spreads, avocado toast with cherry tomatoes, and a square of tiramisu. (7) The woman sits in a booth holding the baby while eating, then stands by the window again for a final shot overlooking the city.

It highlights the ease of access without queuing, the spacious seating suitable for families, breastfeeding-friendliness, and a variety of aesthetically pleasing food and beverages.
